research_contract.target: Verify one pre-Origin budget-ten Selector whose direct target-Agent future pass-rate MAE is lower than Full eligible repository-local history at both H5 and H10 on the fixed-Harness modern development panel.
research_contract.terminal_success: The unchanged frozen candidate is strictly better than Full at both H5 and H10, passes target-column and time audits, reproduces byte-identically, and reports repository, Agent, Origin, and random directions. Random is a calibration diagnostic, not an additional success gate.
research_contract.claim_boundary: Passing establishes an outcome-open modern development candidate only. It does not establish prospective validity, production readiness, or independent unseen-population confirmation.

search_provenance.expert_family: nine historical pooled-rate forecasts by four disagreement weights by two deterministic within-count tie modes
search_provenance.selected_expert: full pooled-rate forecast, lexicographic minimum disagreement, recent-first within equal response-count groups
search_provenance.selected_because: It was the strongest unchanged fixed expert at H5 and also improved H10; it is simpler and had lower direct MAE than the prequential meta policy at both horizons.

routes_actually_run: histogram and nearest-analog response distribution matching
RBF MMD and future-open capacity checks
global_search_disclosure.candidate_count_interpretation: The 72 experts are one local META family, not the global multiplicity. Other route grids overlap and produce different objects, so no false single independent-trial count is asserted.
global_search_disclosure.selection_bias: All primary outcomes were open during this bounded multi-route search. Formal reruns establish reproducibility, not independent confirmation.

candidate.runtime_unit: one target Agent, one repository, one Task Pool, and one Selection
candidate.reference_panel: Exclude the target identity before every aggregation. Within one Selection, use a complete rectangular binary result matrix with the same m >= 2 admitted reference Agents for every eligible historical Task. Development leave-one-target-out uses m=12. If a new target is absent from the reference panel, the same rule is executable, but leave-one-out establishes information exclusion only; it does not establish validity under reference-panel cardinality, Harness, or Agent-population shift.
candidate.forecast: The pooled binary pass rate over every eligible historical Task and every reference Agent.
candidate.task_statistic: For each historical Task, the integer count c of passing reference Agents out of m reference Agents.
candidate.primary_objective: For n eligible historical Tasks, let C_H=sum_H(c). Among ten-distinct-Task subsets S, minimize the exact integer |n*sum_S(c)-10*C_H|. This is equivalent to matching sum_S(c)/(10*m) to C_H/(n*m) without floating-point rounding.
candidate.secondary_objective: Lexicographically minimize sum(c*(m-c)) among primary-objective ties. This prefers reference-panel consensus without trading away the pooled-rate match.
tertiary_ties: for each fixed response-count composition, materialize the most recent Tasks in every equal-c group
if different compositions still tie on the primary and secondary objectives, minimize global_recent_key=(-i_max,-i_second_max,...,-i_min) over canonical history positions i
canonical history position follows created_at then instance_id
candidate.solver: Exact dynamic programming over response-count compositions followed by deterministic membership materialization.
candidate.horizon_parameter: The same Selector is used unchanged at H5 and H10; horizon only determines rolling Origin boundaries and does not alter the objective.

reference_matrix_admission: fixed reference identities and denominator m within a Selection
reject missing outcomes rather than impute them
membership_may_read: current repository-local eligible Task identities and created_at order
historical binary outcomes of admitted reference Agents
membership_must_not_read: the target Agent outcome column at any time
the six project-sealed Agent outcome blobs
information_contract.required_perturbation: Flipping the target Agent complete outcome column must leave every membership unchanged.

frame.aggregation: Average target Agents and Origins inside each repository, then weight repositories equally.
frame.primary_metric: Direct absolute error between selected target-Agent pass rate and next-block target-Agent pass rate.

sensitivity: repositories with more than one Origin
ablations: pooled-rate match without the consensus secondary objective

estimand_definitions.primary_repository_equal_mae: For each repository, average target-Agent-by-Origin absolute errors; then average repository means equally.
estimand_definitions.repository_direction: Compare candidate and Full within each repository after averaging all target-Agent-by-Origin cells in that repository.
estimand_definitions.agent_direction: For each target Agent, average its Origin losses within each repository and then average repositories equally before comparing candidate and Full.
estimand_definitions.origin_direction: For each repository-Origin, average losses across target Agents before comparing candidate and Full.
estimand_definitions.leave_one_repository_out: Remove one repository row and recompute the equal-repository macro over the remainder.
estimand_definitions.origin_weighted: Average repository-Origin rows equally after each row has averaged target Agents; repositories therefore receive weight proportional to Origin count.
estimand_definitions.direction_ties: Use exact computed equality; no tolerance is applied.

required_reporting.random_definition: For each draw and each repository-Origin, sample one uniform ten-Task subset without replacement and share that membership across target Agents. Aggregate target Agents and Origins within repository, then repositories equally. Use NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)); report the distribution against Full and the frozen candidate.

ablation_definitions.consensus_first: Choose ten Tasks by ascending (c*(m-c), -history_position), omitting pooled-rate preservation.

required_reporting.diagnostic_normalization: Per-Task disagreement is c*(m-c)/m^2 before averaging, so panels with different m use the same [0,0.25] scale.

confirmation.secondary_opened_diagnostic: After implementation and primary evidence are bound, replay unchanged on the already-open three-Agent SWE-bench Full lane. This is a transfer diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
confirmation.six_project_sealed_agents: Remain unread in this study. Their legacy population no longer matches the modern fixed-Harness target population and they are not required by the parent development-success contract.
